description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:2109-2121 — The for_each closure mutates two independent external variables: sets matched_via_i = true AND pushes to new_nodes. Using for_each for dual side effects is non-idiomatic. Prefer: let matched_via_i = tree.iter().filter(...).fold(false, |_, parent| { new_nodes.push(...); true }); OR split into .any() for the flag and a separate collect step. The current code is correct but the pattern obscures intent and the iterator protocol guarantees become relevant (for_each is equivalent to a for loop, but the mixed-concern closure is harder to reason about).
title: for_each dual side-effects in match_count loop
